notes.title: Quarter Bounties!
notes.content:
[h1]Bounties are Live![/h1]

You can now use your POQ Quarters to create bounties on other players or put one out on the Arena Boss!  

Bounties are created on a player that is currently in the lobby queue. When the game starts the players have 2 minutes to kill the player with the bounty on them to collect the bounty if the player survives they collect the bounty.   Additionally Bounties can be placed on the first boss that appears and the first player to kill the boss will receive the bounty. 

[list]
[*] It costs at least 100 Quarters to start a bounty.
[*] You can increment bounties by 100. 
[*] Winner takes 1/2 the bounty the other half is split between the game and the Streamer
[*] Your POQ account has to be connected to create or receive quarters
[*] Only one Bounty per round and the player must be in the game
[/list]


!bounty   -> Creates a 100 quarter bounty on the First boss
!bounty @name -> creates a 100 quarter bounty on the @user game
!bounty sa_boss -> creates a 100 quarter bounty on the first boss
!bounty @name 200  -> creates a 200 quarter bounty on the @ name

notes.title: Get ready to !fight for Season 8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38506942/0319de51fe6145679cea5c743ae6301340f29175.png[/img]


Firstly,

Thank you for an amazing Season 7.  It was an incredible one, with a lot of tournaments and new faces - I for one had a ton of fun!  We had 10 Streamers that hit the 7k mark on streamer board, so congrats! 

The all-a-round champion was Mike_And_Chill.  Straight dominating the boards with an Arena Master win as well as taking the Chatiator victory - not to mention an impressive 10k kills on the season! 

[i][b]Which gives us a new 10k Kills in a Season title:[/b][/i]  Attack of the Killer Pineapples!  

[h1]Lets talk about Season 8![/h1]

Being I update the builds through the season, we don't have a lot of 'right out of the gate' changes to the build.    But, there were a couple things that were added along with the standard changes.

[b]New Arena Pass is up.[/b]
Numbers were tweaked a bit, based on completion stats of last couple seasons.

[b]In-Game Drops[/b]
I've increased the amount of Champion Points that you get from the chests to 10.   The idea is to allow you to use the Champion Points to also purchase gold packages, so you can unlock more things a bit quicker without having to use your cash monies.

[b]Alts | Bot accounts[/b]
Ban system is now fully implemented.   People that are abusing the fact that it's easy to create numerous Twitch accounts in an attempt to game Tournaments will be banned without warning.  

[b]Arena Master Bundles[/b]
Working towards a system that rewards streamer's monetarily through a partnership with Arena Master bundles.  Arena Masters will get 30% of a revenue share on purchased bundles, testing this out this Season with the first bundles up for Mike_And_Chill.    Sorry to say these are currently only available on Mobile. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38506942/b4c3a3b1629631b6145b5078e58a6f934b5733e6.png[/img]


[h2]What are you working on this Season though?! [/h2]
[list]
[*] Bugs, polish, and performance.  
[*] More Skin Variants!  (3 incoming for Barry!)
[*] An Arena Master Level-Up Unlock System
[i] want to get more bosses, beasts, spells and things in the arena. But, I want to make them something you earn through streaming and unlock.  This rewards those people that have been playing with uniqueness to their arenas.   Will be working on this during the season. [/i]
[*]b] Bounty System
   [i]Allows you to set in-game currency bounties on players during a game. [/i]
[*] Tournament Token System
[i] Allows You to purchase a tournament tokens within in-game currency, which then rewards players with in-game currency / items for participating and winning tournaments.[/i]
[*] Level up Frames.
[/list]

notes.title: Season 7 Build
notes.content:
[h1]Season 7 Starts at Friday 7/16 GMT 00 - BE THERE! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38506942/621fd066adde8e048c248083baba3ae9606c0594.png[/img]

You can now use your quarters like a maniac in chat!  !quarters <amount> (minimum of 50 quarters) will trigger an event in the game.   ALL quarters go to the content creator you're playing with [b]-- provided they have their POQ account connected --[/b]

Some Arena's have been taken out of commission for the time being.  Arenas going forward are going to follow a certain type of layout formula to ensure the maximum spectating playing view possible.

notes.title: The Bug hunt of doom - Plus a new settings system and bunch more!
notes.content:
[h1] The Pacifist Bug[/h1]

There's been an elusive bug that I've been trying to hunt down where players suddenly wouldn't attack a target, then seemed resigned to their fate as a gladiator and just stood there and took a beat down.   This [b]SEEMS[/b] to be fixed after a lot of testing today. 

[b]Fallback:[/b]
I've put a check in for when a player appears to be just standing around doing something because they can't reach a target.  There is an adverse side-affect to this that I'll continue to improve the logic around, that is that YOU may target something you can't reach and the game might retarget for you because you can't reach it.     So it might seem like the game isn't listening to your targeting, when it's just protecting you from yourself. 

[h1] New Settings Menu[/h1]
Complete rewrite of the settings menu.  Yes that means most of your settings are trashed and you'll have to reset them!    But, I'm now using an INI file instead of internal saving, so it wont reset when you logout or are force logged out.. .and we shouldn't have more settings bugs creeping up as it's a much better handler.

- Leaderboards now are changed by your web cam setting
- There is still some left over work to be done here and I plan on knocking this out over the next two builds and finish adding more settings.    

[h1]AI Upgrade[/h1]
I've updated the AI, which will start helping with future behaviors.   This also means changes to the targeting system which should work a lot better - less back and forth decisions.   There's still more to be done here but it should be a step in the right direction with targeting.

You also now have a VERY SMALL  chance to target a chest when in auto mode. 


[h1]Text Upgrade[/h1]

Upgraded the way the text looks over characters.  It think it's more readable but, some colors can be worse than before. Will continue to improve this and work on getting a limited color range to avoid gnarly colors on names. 

[h1] Bug Fixes[/h1]
 Honestly.. I fixed a ton of crappy code and a few bugs I didn't even realize existed. I don't even remember all the things that were fixed.  I'm sure I created new bugs as I'm working on rewriting and hardening a lot of code. 

[h1]SA CHAT BOT  and Permissions [/h1]
I've merced the SA bot for the moment.  I'll bring it back after I work on a lot of network hardening, there seemed to be some issues with the double client use.   

[b]You need to log out and back in to get the chest messages in your chat, they'll come from  you.[/b]

I've asked for more permissions for your account for the game. This is just for things like Polls, predictions, hype trains.  None of it will be forced on you and will have options to turn off, but I'm working on a lot more integrations with Twitch and engagement that I think will be a lot of fun for all of us. 

[h1]NEW Known ISSUE: [/h1]
]I'm fixing a few of these right now, but I didn't want to wait till Saturday to get this major fix out.

 - You may randomly attack yourself again.. lolkekw 
      - The upgrade on one of the AI modules I use was not backwards compatible and I missed that it overwrote my safety code. 

- If you're chasing someone when they're fleeing the game miscalculates that as time when you're doing something you're not and may retarget you if it takes too long for you todo damage

- The settings upgrade came with a bit of a caveat on that it's using a bunch of new postprocessing, lighting, and settings - so some levels / shadows might be wacked in a few levels.  I'm upgrading the post processing and some other things over the coming weeks.

- You can still get stuck on tight levels like Dave's dungeons, but it shouldn't be for very long.  No more small dungeons, they'll all be upgraded.

notes.title: Event System Update
notes.content:
The patch is a bit larger than normal, even though this disk size should remain about the same.  I updated the engine to the latest version, so we didn't fall too far behind.  I did my best to test the change a lot before pushing this build out, but please let me know if you see anything off!

[h2]- Event System update. 
[/h2]
The old event system was pretty rigid, making it really hard to expand upon.  I've rewritten the entire system to allow for more dynamic chat events.   I've also added in a probability table, so it's more RNG when you use Bits / Tokens / Quarters to fire off events in chat. 

There's only a couple more events right now, but I'll be adding more over the next few builds as the system makes very easy to do so now.     

You can cheer 10+ bits in chat to trigger an event.  The higher the amount (up to 500) will trigger different tier events.  Over 500 will trigger the highest tier events only.   I'll try and get all the spells updated in the wiki in the next week... 

[h3]--  Streamer Spells --[/h3]

The next iteration on the streamer spells loadout is out, I think this is the direction I'm going to go wtih it.  I honestly just wasn't happy with the directions I've gone with it so far.  Later down the road we'll have a full loadout page as you'll be able to earn and slot more spells.  

There was also a major bug with the streamer spells where I don't think certain characters were being affected by some spells and at the very least the amount of damage they should have been doing, they weren't doing.   I've updated the way the spells work and will keep an eye on them. 

[h2]POQ[/h2]

Stream Arenas is now live on https://www.poq.gg/  I highly suggest checking out there platform, I think it's a pretty cool idea!   The backbones of integration with their system is in and soon you'll be able to use quarters to cause spells and the like in the game; with your quarters going to the Streamers as well.  (another way to support the streamers!)

[h3]BUGS[/h3]
- I knocked out a decent little list of bugs - there's still a lot and I'm working on prioritizing them for this next spring.

I plan on 1 more client release for this Season (though, possibly a content release as well)  and more work on the mobile apps.

notes.content:
[h1]The Arena Master is back! [/h1]


You now have a selection of spells that you can use in the Arena (with more to come!).  There are 2 different types of spells that you can spawn in the arena, with a variety of elemental damage. 

[b]Persistent Damage Spells:[/b]
These spells will remain for the entirety of the match, while they may not do a lot of initial damage, their persistent nature makes the arena a lot more hazardous! 


[b]Non-Persistent Spells.[/b]
These spell have a higher out put of damage and are good for securing kills as an Arena Master, these are spawned above the player and have an AOE type damage or some that do high damage and spawn directly on a player. 


Each spell has it's own cooldown, damage, and elemental type.  Elemental Type doesn't play anything in the game at the moment, but later players can get resistance to certain elemental types and you'll be able to level up your Arena Master and unlock multiple types of elemental damage for each spell.

[b]You can find out more about spells on the [url=http://wiki.streamarenas.com/doku.php?id=arena_master]wiki[/url].[/b]


Beast and Bosses will remain automatically spawning.  But, you'll get one Boss per match that will scale better based on the amount of players in the arena.   

You can set up your up your loadout right in the Lobby, so you can change things between matches.

notes.title: Season 3 update!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Season 3! [/h1]

Season 2 was [b]too long![/b]  We can all agree on that, whew.. sweaty.    Season's from now on will be set at a 4week 3 day cadence, optimal pummeling time.    Why 3 days?  Want to kick off the season on Community day and let people have a chance to score some drops right out the door and end on a Sunday for that weekend optimal leaderboard chase.

[h1]Season 3 Kickoff Tournament / Event[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38506942/713f763c2c19ac9ead9915954fa294b6f2b1c8d5.png[/img]

[h1]What's new in Season 3?[/h1]

[b]New Ranking system for Leaderboards. [/b]

There's 9 internal rankings for the Leaderboards, you can think of these as like Tier Rankings.   This allows us to make different segments of the leaderboards more competitive by offering bonuses for killing people X tiers above you. 

So as of now you'll receive bonus points for killing people that are 3+ tiers ahead of you, the scoring is set in away that we should basically have 3 different competitive section on the leaderboards (dependent on amount of players of course). 

The simple way to look at this.     If you're in Tier 3 and kill someone on in Tier 6, you'll gain 2 extra bonus points on the leaderboards. 


[b]Arena Powers Revamp V1[/b]

The Arena Powers were fun for season 2, but they were also a bit awkward.   The inconsistent beasts, bosses depending on where you were playing weren't the best - and though 'auto strimmer' tried, it just didn't make the best of the powers.  Not too mention the 'Helping Lightening' could feel a bit bad if a streamer just tried to decimate the players with it (though, super fun as the streamer at times).  

With that I've removed the control for the powers ([b]BITS still work!![/b]) and the powers will just automagically / randomly occur.  Beasts and bosses will now spawn based on time + amount of people alive. More people? More beasts. 

[b]Brand new Arena Pass[/b]

I love the idea of having a pass that you can earn free goodies in the game; it makes it fun!  But, I also think just straight XP pass is a bit 'drab'.   The pass has been reworked to reward you for achieving different stats during the season, this is the first version towards trying to build out a more 'quest like' reward system through future season (probably a ways off, lots of work to do everywhere!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38506942/2e9b4fbc9a4c246873a1be5336031ccfd1d035d7.png[/img]

[b]Banners and Titles[/b]

You can now earn Banners and Titles through completing quests!  We'll come up with more ways to reward these as the seasons go on.  

Banners will be placed next to you when you win a match.   Titles will be shown below your name in game, you'll be able to equip these in your loadout on steam/Mobile.

[b]More Stuff[/b]
There was a long list of bug changes and just general improvements.   There will be new characters, maps, and more through the season!  Working on a better cadence for releases (rather than just all the time!) to keep some content fresh for the following seasons and to also give myself a break here and there. 

I have lots of plans for the Game and plan on keeping it rolling!   Hope to see you in the arena!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38506942/4198fa16363fa42e240ccc94ebca053268aa970a.png[/img]

notes.title: Release .86 is live
notes.content:
[b]Machu Picchu is Live[/b]! 
Jump in the new Temple themed arena and be crowned the top archeologist ... er Chatiator! 

[b] AI Collision Updates [/b]

 Made changes to the way that AI collision behave, rather than keeping the complete removal of collision on players, I've added it back with a much lower radius than before.  I've also kept the avoidance low, meaning that while Chatiators / beasts / bosses will now go back to colliding with each other, the radius in which they do is significantly smaller.   

This will help with completely stacking on top of each other and hopefully still maintain the ability to have the smaller pathways and stairs not bottle neck.  


[b] Auto Streamer Mode [/b]

This was release last build, but I left it out of patch notes to work on a few issues that I was seeing with it. This still needs some TLC, but you can use it! 

Hitting 'Z" while in an arena will Toggle 'auto mode' which means that game will follow random character, switch focus, and randomly use abilities.   This can be really nice if you're deep in conversation, have to jump up and use the restroom, etc. 

This is a toggle, so hitting Z will turn it on and off.   Plans to evolve this are still in the works for the future. 

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Multiple bug fixes

notes.title: Release .82
notes.content:
introducing [b]Overwhelmed[/b]:

Overwhelmed is an automatic flee mechanic that is implemented to help with everyone targeting and burning down the same person.   If you take damage from 3 or more different targets in quick succession you will flee from the fight.


Introducing [b]Keep it Ten[/b]

Keep it Ten will allow matches that have the minimum requirements (3) Chatiators in the match to fill with bots to 10  players.  This allows for matches to be a bit more exciting and with the AutoHelper for bots and players to kill beasts along the way.  You can toggle this feature on and off in the Settings menu.

- Fleeing will not drop your current targets
- You can change Settings in Game - Hit Escape twice to bring up the menu. 
-  You can now set the In-Game leaderboards up to fit your layout (with scale and all)
- Multiple Bug Fixes.

notes.title: Release .81
notes.content:
[b] Auto Mode
[/b]      This was a big departure from the current state of the game that basically 'enforced' the concept of having to be active in the Arena to have the best chance.   While I still believe being active will give you the biggest run for your money, you'll make a more interesting combatant if you're lurking and playing! 

Auto Mode will make your champion will give your champion a chance to ult / attack beasts.  There is a percentage of chance on each check, so it wont be automatic. 

Auto mode is turned off as soon as you use any sort of command during the match. 

- Added a New Prompt so that I can easily inform people of updates/changes that might be important. 
- Fixed up some event listeners for bots for future stuff
- Collecting dmg stats from rounds
- Changed the End Game Leaderboards a bit to show Last Person Standing / Most Dmg / Most Kills

notes.title: Arena Masters - Now Live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Uqx5kgg6lm8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Welcome to the Arena!  
[/b]0.5  Arena Master Update! 

Thanks everyone for the support of the game so far, I’m really excited about the direction we’re heading now!   This build comes with some major updates including the introduction of the ‘Arena Master’ System.

[b]Arena Master:
[/b]Streamers now gain AP (Action Points) while in the arena, they can use AP to cause chaos in the arena by triggering events.  Events are triggered using the correlating hotkeys for the event (Number key 1-4)

Trigger 1 Confusion.  Confusion costs 10 AP and sets the arena floor into mass chaos, as it forces each Chatiator to retarget! 

Trigger 2:  Lightning.  Lightning costs 15 AP and spawns a cloud over a random Chatiator. This cloud has multiple lightning strikes that can cause severe damage to anyone under them! 

Trigger 3:  Summon Beast:  Summoning a Beast costs 20 AP and spawns in a random Beast.

Trigger 4:  Summon Boss:  Summing a Boss costs 50 AP and summons in a boss to the arena (Bosses are still in works, right now Pincer is available to cause damage, but isn’t quite complete)

[b]Bosses:
[/b]
Bosses have entered the Arena.  Currently, Pincer is available and does standard mass damage attacks.  Bosses are still being worked on with more to come and expanding their functionality a lot.

Spell Casters:

Spell Casters are here!  Currently we have a Priestess that you can get in the game, you can get this right now by participating in community days every sunday!  Will be expanding these and doing some champion rotations in the future. 


[b]Arenas
[/b]
Removed all Arenas but Colosseum and the Desert Arena, to work on getting the rest up to a better streamable / playable feel.  Though they were great ambiance, they just didn’t play as well as these two.

[b]----  Also in this build  ----
[/b]

There was a huge rewrite of a lot of code, settings, and configs.  Please be on the lookout for oddities and let me know so I can fix them! 
[list]
[*] Tab now locks the camera in place
[*] Ults have had a Major update (more to come)
[*] Bits of 500+ spawn a raid boss
[*] Moved Streamer settings to the fight button
[*] Sessions Leaderboard now tracks your wins
[*] Some animation reworks on character
[*] Increased ALL characters health significantly 
[*] Balancing pass on hero damage
[*] Increased the health regained on-hit for Marty (Werewolf)
[*] Global leaders has been reset
[*] Lots of little tweaks and bug fixes (hopefully ;) ) 
[/list]
